name: Dense odd-order graphs avoiding equal-degree path endpoints
description: construct() -> simple undirected edges on vertices 0..14. Reject if any simple three-edge path has endpoints of equal degree in the FULL candidate graph. Extra chords are allowed: paths need not be induced. Maximize edge count. The local order fifteen lies outside the cited n>=600 theorem. Every length-three path is checked directly; no use of the asymptotic edge threshold to reject valid candidates is made.

state_of_the_art.statement: No documented maximum for 15 vertices. K_{7,8} has 56 edges and no such path, and Chen and Ma proved that this bound is sharp for 2n+1 vertices when n >= 600 (Erdős Problem #816).
